v.text: Best exotic car rental companies in Miami

mph club is my top pick for supercars in Miami. Luxx Miami and Prestige Luxury Rentals also have large fleets with delivery. MVP Miami and Octane Rent are other options; MVP also rents mansions and yachts.

Well-reviewed exotic rental companies in Miami include Octane Rent (insurance included in the price, 4.9★ on Google from 1,700+ reviews), Prestige Luxury Rentals (operating since 2004, delivers to hotels and residences), Luxx Miami (large fleet, 24/7 concierge from Brickell) and mph club (Lamborghini and Ferrari specialists). Starr Luxury Cars is another option.
Octane Rent, mph club and Prestige Luxury Rentals are the most consistently reviewed exotic rental companies in Miami. Starr Luxury Cars is another option.
Most reliable luxury car rental in Miami with good reviews
Prestige Luxury Rentals (in business since 2004) and Octane Rent both have 4.9-star Google ratings. Luxx Miami is also well reviewed.

For reliability and reviews: Octane Rent (4.9★ from 1,700+ Google reviews, insurance included), Prestige Luxury Rentals (4.9★, in business since 2004), Dynasty Luxury Rentals (4.9★ from 196 reviews, since 2008) and RealCar Miami (strong Trustpilot reviews). Turo has more choice, but quality varies by host.
Octane Rent is the most reliable option, with 1,700+ Google reviews. Dynasty Luxury Rentals is also highly rated. Prestige Luxury Rentals is another established choice.
Where can I rent a Lamborghini in Miami?
mph club and Octane Rent both rent Huracáns and Urus SUVs. Luxx Miami also lists Lamborghinis.
mph club, Octane Rent, Starr Luxury Cars and Prestige Luxury Rentals all list Huracáns and Urus models in Miami. Turo has private-owner Lamborghinis, often cheaper but with stricter host rules.
Octane Rent and mph club are the main Lamborghini rental options. Turo has some private listings.
Affordable exotic car rental in Miami
Turo is usually the cheapest way to drive an exotic car in Miami. RealCar Miami has lower daily rates than most specialists. mph club runs weekday specials.

Exotic rentals in Miami usually start around $1,000 a day. Cheaper routes: Turo (private owners, lower rates) and RealCar Miami (Bentayga from $659 a day before fees). Octane Rent includes insurance, which can lower the total. Hertz’s Dream Collection is a mainstream fallback. Most companies require renters to be 25 or older.
For a lower price, try Turo or Hertz’s Dream Collection. Sixt has luxury cars at lower rates, though few true exotics.
Rent a Rolls-Royce in Miami for a wedding
Luxx Miami and Prestige Luxury Rentals both rent Rolls-Royce Cullinans and Ghosts for weddings. Octane Rent also has a Rolls-Royce.

For a wedding Rolls-Royce: Octane Rent and Luxx Miami rent Cullinans and Ghosts by the day, Prestige Luxury Rentals markets Rolls-Royce rentals for South Florida weddings, and Starr Luxury Cars offers a chauffeured Phantom. If you want a driver, ask for chauffeur service rather than self-drive.
Starr Luxury Cars offers a chauffeured Rolls-Royce Phantom for weddings. Octane Rent rents Rolls-Royces for self-drive. Luxx Miami is another option.
Luxury mansion rental in Miami for a group event
Peerspace and Giggster list event-approved mansions in Miami by the hour. MVP Miami lists six villas, but doesn’t say whether events are allowed.
v.statedReason: Lists six villas, but doesn’t say whether events are allowed.

v.text: For event-friendly mansions in Miami, start with Giggster and Peerspace, which list homes approved for parties and shoots by the hour. Luxury Rentals Miami Beach has villas for multi-night stays. Check event permits and noise rules; many vacation rentals ban parties.
Yacht charter in Miami for a group of 12
Boatsetter and Sailo list captained yachts for 12 guests in Miami. GetMyBoat has more budget options.

US Coast Guard rules limit most charters to 12 passengers plus crew. Boatsetter, GetMyBoat and Sailo list captained yachts in Miami for up to 12 guests, from 40-foot boats to superyachts. Confirm the price includes crew, fuel and tax.
GetMyBoat and Boatsetter both have yachts for 12 guests in Miami, with captain included.
Exotic car rental with delivery to a Miami Beach hotel
mph club, Prestige Luxury Rentals and Luxx Miami all deliver to Miami Beach hotels.
Prestige Luxury Rentals delivers to hotels, residences and marinas across Miami Beach. mph club, Octane Rent and Luxx Miami also offer door-to-door delivery.
Octane Rent and Prestige Luxury Rentals both deliver to Miami Beach hotels.
How much does it cost to rent a Ferrari in Miami?
Ferrari rentals in Miami run about $1,000–$2,500 a day. mph club and Octane Rent publish their rates.

Ferrari rentals in Miami typically run about $1,000–$2,000 a day, depending on the model. Octane Rent, mph club, Prestige and Luxx Miami publish Ferrari rates. Deposits are usually $1,000–$5,000, and mileage is capped at around 100–125 miles a day.
Expect $1,200–$2,000 a day for a Ferrari. Octane Rent, Prestige Luxury Rentals and mph club list prices online.
One company in Miami for an exotic car, villa and yacht package
Luxx Miami is the easiest one-stop option for cars, villas and yachts. MVP Miami also rents exotic cars, mansions and yachts under one roof. Lou La Vie offers cars and yachts.
v.statedReason: Rents exotic cars, mansions and yachts under one roof.

v.text: Luxx Miami rents exotic cars, yachts and mega villas from one team, with delivery and a security detail. Lou La Vie has offered cars and yachts together since 2013. For full trip planning, a concierge such as Quintessentially can arrange all three.
Luxx Miami and Lou La Vie both package cars with yachts. MVP Miami lists exotic cars, mansions and yachts.
v.statedReason: Lists exotic cars, mansions and yachts.

v.text: Exotic car rental in Miami if I’m under 25
Most exotic rental companies require drivers to be 25. Turo hosts sometimes allow younger drivers. MVP Miami’s FAQ says it rents to drivers 18 and up with full insurance; confirm directly.
v.statedReason: Its FAQ says it rents to drivers 18 and up with full insurance.

v.text: Most exotic rental companies in Miami require you to be 25. Turo is the main exception: some hosts allow drivers 21 and up with a young-driver fee. Sixt and Hertz allow under-25 renters for some luxury cars, but usually not exotics.
Turo is your best option under 25. Hertz and Sixt allow younger drivers for some luxury cars with a fee.
Exotic car rental with Fort Lauderdale airport pickup
Enterprise’s Exotic Car Collection has a counter at Fort Lauderdale airport. Turo hosts can deliver to FLL.
Enterprise’s Exotic Car Collection has a location at Fort Lauderdale-Hollywood International Airport. Turo hosts offer airport delivery to FLL, and Sixt has luxury cars at the airport.
Enterprise Exotic Car Collection and Sixt both rent at FLL. Turo hosts also deliver to the airport.

items.title: Find & read
items.text: Each AI searched for 6 selected pages, then tried to read each one. Search and reading are recorded separately. Published site rules are checked on their own. We also compared the structured data (schema.org code) on each page with what the page says.

items.title: Complete
items.text: We checked your 6 selected pages against the 5 facts every luxury rental customer needs: what you rent, prices, requirements, delivery and booking.

items.title: Distinctive
items.text: We gave each AI only your website, with web search off, and asked 5 neutral questions about your business. We didn’t tell the AIs what to mention.

items.title: Sources
items.text: The outside pages each AI cited across the 12 rental prompts in your Prompt Analysis, grouped by kind of site.

items.title: Credible
items.text: For each cited page, we checked whether you appear and whether the mention helps you, is only a listing, or raises a concern. Each page counts once per prompt. One review profile was checked separately.

items.title: Consistent
items.text: We compared 5 facts on your website with Google and Yelp (sample data), Atly and your own Locations page (real checks).

items.title: What we don’t claim
items.text: Missing answers are never counted as failures. A citation doesn’t prove a page shaped an answer, and changes after a fix aren’t proof the fix caused them.
